 Tamil Nadu CM Vijay to felicitate top-scoring board exam students in Chennai 
 A felicitation event will take place in Chennai for exceptional Class 10 and 12 students. Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay will honor these students as part of the ceremony. PTI 
 Published On Nov 04, 2026 at 10:21 AM IST

 Tamil Nadu chief minister C Joseph Vijay Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay will felicitate top-performing students of Class 10 and 12 public exams from Tamil Nadu and Puducherry in the first phase of an award ceremony here on Wednesday. According to an official announcement, the event is aimed at encouraging meritorious students and will be held at the R K Convention Centre in Neelankarai, Chennai. The first phase of the felicitation will cover students from 30 assembly constituencies spread across five districts: Ariyalur, Cuddalore, Kallakurichi, Tiruvannamalai, and Villuppuram. The event will begin at 11 am with the admission of students and their parents into the venue. The main ceremony is scheduled for 2 pm, during which Chief Minister Vijay will personally distribute certificates and financial incentives to the high-scoring students in the presence of their parents.
